checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'ab-test-plan'.

checks.description: The test changes exactly one variable.
checks.rule: Body requires exactly one variable under test, holding everything else constant, and instructs narrowing the test if a second variable would move.

checks.description: The hypothesis is tied to the strategy-artifact success_metric.
checks.rule: Body requires a written hypothesis tied to the success_metric set in the strategy-artifact, not a vanity metric, and stops-and-asks if the success_metric is absent.

checks.description: A stop rule is defined up front.
checks.rule: Body requires a stop rule (sample size or duration plus a decision threshold) set before the test runs, with no moving the goalposts after the fact.

checks.description: The sample size is derived from a baseline and an MDE, with a named method chosen before launch.
checks.rule: Body and template require a baseline rate, a minimum detectable effect, a derived per-arm sample size, and a significance level (or a named sequential or Bayesian method), with the method and stop rule chosen before launch and no peeking.

checks.description: The test is a proposal through the human gate.
checks.rule: Body states the plan is a human-gate proposal and the skill never launches or spends on its own.
Body states the hypothesis judges against the success_metric, never a vanity metric.
templates/ab-test-plan.md exists and contains variable_under_test, hypothesis, variants A and B, split/audience/window, and stop_rule sections.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash character.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear in any file; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic text.
checks.rule: No file contains the U+0640 tatweel character.
